# Joe Manchin retains West Virginia Senate seat for Democrats

Sen. Joe Manchin's moderate streak and his cordial ties to President Donald Trump made him a tough target for the Republican Party. | Patrick Smith/Getty Images

By Connor O’Brien 11/06/2018 09:13 PM EST

Democratic Sen. Joe Manchin won reelection in West Virginia on Tuesday, beating Republican state Attorney General Patrick Morrisey and denying the GOP a Senate pickup in a state President Donald Trump carried by a huge margin in 2016.

Manchin had 51 percent of the vote to Morrisey’s 45 percent with 39 percent of precincts reporting when three television networks called the race. Manchin’s moderate streak, his long streak of political wins and his cordial ties to President Donald Trump made him a tough target for the Republican Party.
